evidence_locators: NEJM 390(18):1649–1662; PMID 38661449; efficacy endpoint (severe VOC); data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)
ai-science-lab/outputs/scd-published-endpoint.json (29/30, Wilson 95% CI 82.8–99.9; 44 participants infused)

excerpts.claim_text: 30 of 30 participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial were free from severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 consecutive months (broader severe-VOE definition: hospital/ER observation lasting ≥24 h, or ≥2 visits to a day unit or ER over a 72-h period; IV treatment required).
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; PMID 40146367; 'These papers share a study group'

excerpts.claim_text: The broad severe-VOC endpoint in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial counts medical-facility visits of any duration, regardless of the treating provider or cause of the visit.
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; Table 1/Table 2 (exa-cel severe-VOC endpoint definition: medical facility visit of any duration; no alternative cause; oral or IV treatment; severe VOCs for exa-cel, SCPCs for crizanlizumab/l-glutamine, VOC for voxelotor).

excerpts.claim_text: Eight of 30 participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial were not free from severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 consecutive months.
evidence_locators: NEJM 390(18):1649–1662; PMID 38661449; efficacy endpoint; data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)

excerpts.claim_text: F-cell durability was followed for more than 12 months after the 12-month endpoint in the CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial.
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; endpoint reanalysis, data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)

excerpts.claim_text: 29 participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 trial had at least 12 consecutive months free of severe vaso-occlusive crises.
evidence_locators: NEJM 390(18):1649–1662; PMID 38661449; efficacy endpoint; data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)

excerpts.claim_text: The CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial (severe SCD) enrolled 12–35 year old participants with a history of at least 2 severe vaso-occlusive crises per year for 2 years prior to enrollment.
evidence_locators: Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; Methods: 'Inclusion criteria for participants in the CLIMB SCD-121 trial included: (1) 12–35 years of age, (2) confirmed diagnosis of severe SCD, and (3) a history of at least 2 severe VOCs per year in the 2 years prior to study screening.'

excerpts.claim_text: Hydroxyurea sustains elevated F-cell proportions in the Townes humanized mouse model at P14 (≈20% F cells).
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'the proportion of F cells in peripheral blood was 100% at P0, declined sharply to 20% at P2... Hydroxyurea given at P2 significantly sustained elevated percentages of F cells in mice at P14' (Exp Hematol 112–113, 2022 Aug–Sep)

excerpts.claim_text: Without hydroxyurea, F cells in the Townes mouse model are virtually undetectable at P14.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'the percentage of F cells declined at P14 for treatment begun at P4... F cells were virtually undetectable at P14' (no HU control context — F cells in this model decline after birth)

excerpts.claim_text: Hydroxyurea augments γ-globin mRNA transcription in the Townes mouse model erythroid tissues.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'A lack of augmentation of γ-globin mRNA in erythroid tissues suggests that the apparent increase in HbF in red cells caused by hydroxyurea was not due to sustained or re-activation of γ-globin transcription, but was instead a function of erythropoiesis suppression.'

excerpts.claim_text: F cells in the Townes mouse model are 100% of peripheral blood at P0.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'the proportion of F cells in peripheral blood was 100% at P0'

excerpts.claim_text: γ-globin RNA augmentation in the Townes mouse model erythroid tissues under hydroxyurea is quantified with numeric values.
evidence_locators: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract — 'lack of augmentation' stated qualitatively; no quantitative γ-globin values in the pilot record

excerpts.claim_text: γ-globin RNA is enriched ~100-fold in F versus A erythroblasts in the F/A erythroblast study (qRT-PCR; F/A ratio).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Figure 1B — qRT-PCR of HBG in F vs A (~100-fold; F erythroblasts sort)

excerpts.claim_text: γ-globin RNA makes up about 30% of total globin transcripts in F cells (ddRT-PCR).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358 — 'the γ-globin accounts for ~30% of total globin transcripts, similar to 14–28% previously noted by quantitative immunofluorescence in adult erythrocyte F cells.'

excerpts.claim_text: γG-globin protein is concordant with γ-globin RNA in F versus A erythroblasts (fluorescent western blot).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Figure 1C — 'Western blot analysis was concordant with the RNA results'

excerpts.claim_text: RNA-seq of the F/A erythroblast study shows γ-globin as an F-cell-enriched transcript (globin-RNA depleted).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Methods — RNA-seq 'after depletion of ribosomal RNA and globin RNA'; supplemental GSE144052 (pilot gap P-007)

excerpts.claim_text: F and A erythroblasts in the F/A study were matched by CD71, CD235 and forward scatter at the differentiation stage analyzed.
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Methods — 'gated using a viability marker and then matched for forward scatter, CD71, and CD235'

excerpts.claim_text: At day 7 of differentiation, F erythroblasts in the F/A study carry ~30% of total globin as γ-globin (ddRT-PCR).
evidence_locators: Blood 2020 135(22):1957–1968; PMC7256358; Figure 1B/1D (stage-matched F vs A; ddRT-PCR: γ = ~30% of total globin)

excerpts.claim_text: All six patients in the BCL11A-silencing gene therapy pilot achieved robust and stable HbF induction (percentage HbF/(F+S) 20.4–41.3%) at most recent follow-up (7–29 months).
evidence_locators: NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — 'All the patients who could be fully evaluated achieved robust and stable HbF induction (percentage HbF/(F+S) at most recent follow-up, 20.4 to 41.3%)'

excerpts.claim_text: F-cells constitute 58.9–93.6% of untransfused red cells in the BCL11A-silencing pilot.
evidence_locators: NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — 'F-cells 58.9 to 93.6% of untransfused red cells'

excerpts.claim_text: HbF per F-cell is 9.0–18.6 pg in the BCL11A-silencing pilot.
evidence_locators: NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — 'HbF per F-cell of 9.0 to 18.6 pg per cell'

excerpts.claim_text: Clinical manifestations of sickle cell disease were reduced or absent during the BCL11A-silencing pilot follow-up.
evidence_locators: NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — 'Clinical manifestations of sickle cell disease were reduced or absent during the follow-up period'

excerpts.claim_text: The BCL11A-silencing pilot (BCH-BB694 lentiviral vector, autologous CD34+ cells) enrolled six patients (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03282656).
evidence_locators: NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — six patients followed for ≥6 months; pilot is NCT03282656

excerpts.claim_text: F-cell durability of the BCL11A-silencing pilot was followed beyond the scored follow-up window.
evidence_locators: NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990 — no F-cell durability data recorded beyond the scored follow-up

excerpts.claim_text: Direct per-cell HbF quantification shows a 4 pg HbF/RBC protective threshold; vaso-occlusive crisis incidence decreased at the threshold of 4 pg (Am J Hematol 95(11):1235–1245; PMID 32681733; 14 SCD patients, before/during hydroxyurea).
evidence_locators: Am J Hematol 95(11):1235–1245; PMID 32681733; abstract — 'a significant decrease in RBC population containing less than 2 pg of HbF/RBC was observed... decrease in the pathognomonic vaso-occlusive crisis incidence from the threshold of 4 pg'

excerpts.claim_text: A significant decrease in the RBC population containing less than 2 pg of HbF/RBC was observed during hydroxyurea treatment (Am J Hematol 2020).
evidence_locators: Am J Hematol 95(11):1235–1245; PMID 32681733; abstract — 'A significant decrease in RBC population containing less than 2 pg of HbF/RBC was observed' (during HU treatment)
